IC1: Male [OR] and female patients between the ages of 18-65 years, inclusive
IC2: Patients (or legal representative) willing and able to provide written Informed Consent Form.
IC3: Psychiatric patients already diagnosed of schizophrenia [OR] or bipolar disorder, according to the Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders- IV [OR], Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders- V [OR] or International Code of Disease criteria.
IC4: Patients with an on-going agitation episode, or with a previous one within the 6 months prior to screening, attended and managed in the hospital setting.
IC5: Previously treated with ADASUVE® with a positive outcome (responders) according to (CGI-I) scale (defined as having a CGI-I score of 1 or 2 at 2 hours after administration of the inhalation)
IC6: Patients  [NOT] free of active respiratory disease such as acute respiratory signs /symptoms (e.g., wheezing) [OR] or with active airways disease (asthma [OR], chronic obstructive pulmonary disease [OR] or emphysema).
IC7: Requirement of family or other caregiver support at study investigator criteria (defined as a patient's relative or caregiver (male or female) = 80 year old, who spend = 3 consecutive hours with patient, with good physical and psychological health status and without physical limitations, reading and writing educational level and able to understand and follow the study procedures).
IC8: Availability of patient's medical records data about the previous treatment with ADASUVE® at hospital setting.
IC9: If a female is of childbearing potential and sexually active (except if female is surgically sterile or post-menopausal with history of no menses for at least 24 months), patient must be non-lactating and non-pregnant (with a negative pregnancy test result at baseline visit) and have to agree to use a medically acceptable and effective birth control method throughout the study and for one week following the end of the study.
